about.heroSubtitle: Two decades of experience in professional education.
about.historyP1: Ilia Ltd – Ilia Chavchavadze Community College of Sagarejo has been operating since 2000 and over two decades has become one of the most important centers for the development of professional education in the region. The college is multi-profile and offers students the opportunity to gain modern knowledge and practical skills in various fields. The college actively participates in the life of the local community and makes a significant contribution to the development of the region through its activities. For the people of Sagarejo, the college is not just an educational institution, but a source of initiatives and opportunities that promotes new ideas, cooperation, and professional growth. Today, when the education of young people and improvement of their labor prospects is particularly important in the region, the college continues to fulfill its mission — to provide quality professional education, promote the implementation of innovative approaches, and become an exemplary educational space that opens new opportunities for future generations.
about.reputationDesc: Over the years, the college has built a solid reputation as a reliable educational institution distinguished not only by academic quality but also by a student-oriented environment. The professionalism of teachers, special emphasis on practical learning, and cooperation with partner organizations creates an educational space that effectively combines theory and practice. Educational programs address new and in-demand professions, which is particularly important in terms of expanding employment opportunities in the region and increasing choices for young people.
about.reputationP2: From the very beginning, the college aimed to ensure access to education for young people and adults, to create programs tailored to the needs of the local labor market, and to promote the socio-economic progress of the region.

0.title: Authorization Success - College Secures 6-Year Status
0.description:
On January 16, 2026, by decision of the Authorization Council, Ilia Ltd – Ilia Chavchavadze Community College of Sagarejo secured authorization for a period of 6 years!

This is the result of our team's hard work, professionalism, and striving for development.

Congratulations to the college staff, students, graduates, and all supporters on this great success! 🎉📚

1.description: Amazing and unforgettable days, new friends, and opportunities. Thanks to CARE Caucasus for such support and initiatives!

4.title: First Aid Training at the College!
4.description:
📚 First aid training was held at Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College, attended by vocational students and administration representatives.

The training was led by Doctor Ekaterine Kurkhuli, who shared necessary knowledge and practical skills with the participants for quick and effective response in emergency cases.

💬 The training took place in an interactive environment with practical examples and active participation. Participants learned the principles of fast and effective response in emergency situations — the basics of managing cardiac arrest, bleeding, fractures, and other critical situations.

💬 This type of training helps create a safe and responsible environment both in the educational process and in everyday life.

📸 Thanks to the trainer and the participants for their active involvement.

🎯 Such activities raise awareness, strengthen the safety culture, and prepare students for crucial action in real life, where every minute matters❗️

5.title: The Project "For a Safe and Equal Society" Successfully Continues
5.description:
The project "For a Safe and Equal Society", organized by the NNLE "CARE Caucasus", actively and successfully continues at Ilia Chavchavadze Community College.

✨ This topic is always relevant and stands out for its high level of participant involvement.

💡 The knowledge and experience shared by the trainer, Mrs. Tamara Gurchiani, directly reaches each listener and finds its way.

🤝 Many thanks to the project organizers CARE Caucasus for their important work!

6.title: Two-Day Workshop: Outcome-Oriented Learning and Competency-Based Assessment
6.description:
A two-day training/workshop was held at Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College on the topic: 'Outcome-oriented learning – planning the teaching process and competency-based assessment system in vocational education'.

🎓 The training was conducted by guest expert Nino Tamazashvili.

👩🏫 The meeting was attended by vocational teachers of the college, who had the opportunity to share practical experience and discuss modern approaches in learning and assessment.

🤝 Such events contribute to raising the quality of vocational education and the continuous professional development of teachers.

7.title: Presentation of the Strategic and Action Plan
7.description:
On August 22, 2025, Ilia Ltd – Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College hosted a presentation of the drafts of the Strategic Plan (2025–2032) and the Action Plan (2025–2026) prepared by the college's working group.

The purpose of the presentation was to introduce the long-term vision, priority areas, and specific future objectives of the college development to vocational students, staff, and stakeholders. The report for the Action Plan (2023-2025) was also presented.

We share these drafts with you and ask you to carefully review the documents and provide us with your comments and recommendations.

Your feedback is important to ensure the final documents fully reflect the needs and shared vision of the college.

📄 Strategic Development Plan: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1lWsQaNmFNncG9_2Uw_h6hNRQdlp9lCxG/edit?usp=drive_link&ouid=102017355951338243852&rtpof=true&sd=true

📊 Action Plan: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/10IAFtgfXLkE7U7bLLGXrpFvZ5joSsHhN/edit?usp=drive_link&ouid=102017355951338243852&rtpof=true&sd=true

8.title: Veterinary Students Successfully Passed the Qualification Exam!
8.description:
Today at Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College, veterinary vocational program students successfully passed their qualification exam — both theoretical and practical parts!

All students passed the exam successfully! 💪🎓

It is always a joy to see that the work of teachers yields results — our students are already accomplished professionals ❤️

🙏 Thanks to the vocational teachers for sparing no effort for them and standing by them on this path!

Parting is sad, but this is only the beginning of a new phase. We will always be one team and support each other! 💫

We are proud that with you, our region and country will have professional veterinarians! 🐶

9.title: The 25th Jubilee Year of the College Has Begun!
9.description:
Today started the 25th, jubilee year of success at Ilia Ltd – Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College!

💼 As part of the jubilee year, the college expressed its heartfelt gratitude to employers, partners, students, graduates, and the united college team, who have made exceptional contributions to the college's success and development.

✅️ We introduced the college mission to the audience, the main goal of which is to provide high-quality vocational education by creating an environment oriented on successful employment and development.

🏅 Certificates were awarded to outstanding vocational teachers and administrative staff — Rodami Mchedlishvili, Ia Kviriashvili, Pikria Saginashvili — for their high responsibility, professionalism, and enthusiasm in the college's activities.

🎖️ Certificates of appreciation were also awarded to students and graduates with high academic performance, whose achievements are the college's pride!

📚 Studies resumed for autumn intake students in the following programs:

🔹 Pharmacy (Pharmacy Practice)

🔹 Veterinary

🔹 Preschool Educator

🔹 Information Technology

🎓 In addition, diplomas were awarded to the graduates of the 2023–2024 academic year in the Pharmacy (Pharmacy Practice) and Veterinary fields.

✨ At the event, the Quality Assurance Manager highlighted the college's achievements and paid special attention to the high enrollment rate of vocational students in 2025, which is the result of student trust and continuous development.

🩷🙏 We want to thank everyone who shapes our college - its history, success, and vision for the future. Let's meet even more successful years together!

10.title: Workshop: Cream Cheese Preparation Technology
10.description:
On October 22, another workshop organized by FAO Georgia was held at Ilia Chavchavadze Community College, this time on the topic: 'Cream Cheese Preparation Technology'.

The workshop turned out to be very interesting and practical — students not only received theoretical knowledge but also took the initiative to actively participate in the cream cheese preparation process. 🙌

At the end of the event, everyone tasted the amazingly delicious product made by their own hands together with Kakhetian Shoti bread. 😋

11.title: Ideathon in Kakheti: Your Way to Innovation
11.description:
On October 21, a two-day workshop concluded at Ilia Chavchavadze Community College: 'Your Way to Innovation – Ideathon in Kakheti', which was organized by the Innovation and Technology Agency (GITA).

The event was conducted in an interactive and active working mode — participants discussed interesting ideas and developed their creative vision for innovative projects. 🚀

Vocational students gained valuable experience that will help strengthen their professional and personal skills. 🙌

✨️ Such events promote the development of innovative thinking in young people and the discovery of new opportunities! 🌟

12.title: A Special Date in the History of Ilia Chavchavadze Community College
12.description:
🎉 A Special Date in the History of Ilia Chavchavadze Community College 🎉

📅 On December 25, 2025, the Ilia Chavchavadze Community College of Sagarejo solemnly celebrated its 25th anniversary.

The event was attended by deputy mayors of Sagarejo municipality, vocational students, teachers, graduates, administration, and invited guests.

College was founded on December 25, 2000, established by Mr. Ioseb Matiashvili and Mrs. Tamar Abulashvili.

The attendees paid tribute with a minute of silence to the memory of Mr. Ioseb Matiashvili — a person who made an exceptional contribution to the formation and development of the college.

🤝 Over the past 25 years, the college, with a united team, effort, and strong spirit, has withstood many challenges and successfully passed the path of development. Every year was an important step towards the next success❗️

The college is proud of its graduates and their achievements.✨️

The attendees once again emphasized the college's existence and its important role in the social and educational development of the region.

Diplomas were solemnly handed over to the graduates of the vocational programs – Information Technology and Preschool Educator✨️🎓

🎂 At the end of the event, the festive cake was symbolically cut by young Ioseb Matiashvili and Quality Assurance Manager Nino Tetiashvili.

🌟 25 Years — Experience • Unity • Development • Future Successes! 🌟

13.title: Our Best: Master Teacher of Vocational Education – 2025
13.description:
Our Best!

14.title: Meeting on: Cybersecurity and Artificial Intelligence
14.description:
On December 2, a meeting was held at the Ilia Chavchavadze Community College on the topic: "Cybersecurity and Artificial Intelligence".

✨️The meeting was led by Giorgi Mushkudiani, a current lecturer in cybersecurity at the European University and the Georgian Technical University.

Topics discussed:

🤖 Artificial Intelligence in Cybersecurity — New Reality and Challenges;

🤖 Detecting Deepfakes — How to distinguish between real and AI-generated material;

🎣 Phishing Techniques — How to recognize sophisticated lies and protect your personal information.

🎯 The event was quite interesting — there was high interaction, engagement, and interest from the attending audience.

🙏 Thanks to each participant for their active participation!

15.title: Veterinary Program: Chemistry Lab on Inorganic Compounds
15.description:
Vocational program: Veterinary Medicine
Module: Chemistry
Vocational teacher: Rodami Mchedlishvili

As part of the program, students and their teacher carried out laboratory work on the topic "Chemical Properties of Inorganic Compounds".

The aim of the lab was for students to study the chemical properties of inorganic compounds in practice, run experiments and analyze the results. Students observed various reactions first-hand, described their observations and drew conclusions.

Laboratory work helps students apply theoretical knowledge in practice, develop research skills and deepen their professional competencies.

16.title: Developing Career Management Services in Vocational Education
16.description:
Another important step towards developing career management services in vocational education!

On March 12, representatives of Ilia Chavchavadze Community College took part in a working meeting organized by the Skills Agency on the topic: "Ensuring the quality of career management services through continuous professional development (CPD) of career management specialists in Georgia's TVET ecosystem."

The college was represented by Quality Assurance Manager Nino Tetiashvili and Pikria Saginashvili, specialist in the learning process, career guidance and career planning.

The aim of the meeting was to validate the modules of a career management training course developed by experts. After each module was presented, an active discussion followed, where participants shared important recommendations based on their professional experience and practical insights.

Meetings like this help develop and improve career management services in vocational education, helping vocational students plan and build their career paths more effectively.

Ilia Chavchavadze Community College is always actively involved in the development of vocational education and continues to build a strong, results-oriented career support system for its students.

17.title: Thank You to Biotecsi and Roqi
17.description: Sincere thanks to Biotecsi, a manufacturer of veterinary medicines, and its distributor Roqi for their continued support of our students, their warm welcome, and their contribution to the development of vocational education!

18.title: Pharmacy Program: Lab Work on Reactions and Solutions
18.description:
Vocational program: Pharmacy (Pharmaceutical Services)
Module: "Classification of Substances and Their Physical and Chemical Properties"
Vocational teacher: Rodami Mchedlishvili

Topic: reactions of inorganic substances; preparing normal, molar and percentage solutions.

During the lab work, students practiced:

• how chemical reactions proceed
• correct techniques for preparing solutions
• calculating and applying concentrations

Practical experience is the foundation of a successful professional future!

19.title: Three-Day Professional Development Training for Teachers
19.description:
Teaching, practice, results — this is professional development!

A three-day professional development training for teachers is under way at Ilia Chavchavadze Community College on the topic: "Student-Centered Learning and Effective Ways of Communicating with Employers".

During the training, participants are discussing modern approaches to student-centered teaching, vocational education standards, modern theories of student motivation, the importance of Universal Design for Learning in curricula, effective communication in the learning process and other key topics.

The training uses interactive methods, practical tasks and experience sharing.

Special thanks to the trainer, adult education expert Nino Elbakidze — a highly qualified professional, deeply passionate about the work, who keeps participants actively engaged and creates a special, positive atmosphere.

The training ends tomorrow, when participants will summarize what they have learned and share their feedback.

21.description:

24.title: Waste2Wealth: College Staff Selected for International Training of Trainers
24.description:
International experience and new opportunities for the college!

Fifteen participants were selected for the Training of Trainers announced under the Georgian Farmers' Association project "Waste to Wealth" (Waste2Wealth, W2W) — including two representatives of Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College: veterinarian Eka Buzariashvili and Quality Assurance Manager Nino Tetiashvili.

The training includes several sessions and aims to share modern knowledge and practice in environmental and innovative fields.

The first in-person meeting was held on May 5 and covered:

• efficient use of agricultural waste
• opportunities for biogas and biochar production
• introducing sustainable and energy-efficient technologies

The training was led by German and Swedish professionals, who shared both theoretical knowledge and practical experience with the participants.

Importantly, the college is already planning to launch short-term vocational training programs in this field, strengthening modern, in-demand, skills-based teaching.

Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College continues to actively engage in international cooperation and innovative projects!

25.title: Presentation of a New Pharmacy Textbook
25.description:
A presentation of a new textbook created for the Pharmacy (Pharmaceutical Services) program was held at Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College.

The book was written by vocational teacher Rodami Mchedlishvili, based on the module "Classification of Substances and Their Physical and Chemical Properties".

Key strengths of the textbook:

• the full content of the module in a single book
• complete coverage of learning outcomes and performance criteria
• material presented in simple, clear language
• useful for both vocational teachers and students

The event was attended by representatives of vocational education and the pharmaceutical field, professors and teachers, and others interested in the field.

The presentation was lively and interactive, with a Q&A session in which attendees discussed the importance of the textbook, the development of vocational education and its practical use in the learning process.

We congratulate the author on this important achievement and wish many more professional successes in the future!

26.title: Caregiver Program: Creative Learning Activities
26.description:
Learning activities full of creativity and enthusiasm!

Within the vocational program "Caregiver", under the guidance of program head and vocational teacher Maiko Kokhtashvili, in the module "Supporting Physical and Sensory Development in Early and Preschool Age", vocational students showed remarkable creativity and engagement.

The students presented diverse and fun activities that support children's physical, sensory and creative development. The activities stood out for their interesting approaches, practical elements and ideas tailored to children's age-specific needs.

We are proud of our students' creative skills and professional growth!

Study with us and receive a state-recognized bilingual diploma. Remember — it's never too late to learn.

27.title: Private Colleges Association Peer Visit in Batumi
27.description:
On June 5–6, representatives of member colleges of the Georgian Private Colleges Association gathered for a peer visit hosted by Batumi Navigation Teaching University.

Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College was represented by Quality Assurance Manager Nino Tetiashvili.

The main topics of the visit were:

• career guidance
• distance learning
• analysis of administrative procedures

Peer visits help deepen cooperation between vocational education institutions, share best practices and further improve the quality of vocational education.

28.description:
The exam schedule has been announced!

29.title: New at the College: Collegial Learning Sessions #1
29.description:
New at the college! Collegial Learning Sessions — #1

Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College has launched a professional initiative — "Collegial Learning Sessions" — built on sharing experience, development and cooperation!

In each session, a teacher delivers a 10–20 minute demonstration lesson fragment, while colleagues take on the role of students. Every session includes self-assessment and peer feedback, giving participants the chance to analyze their own practice and gain new ideas.

Collegial learning is based on mutual respect, cooperation and sharing professional experience. Its aim is not to evaluate one another, but to learn from each other, discover effective teaching approaches and create a professional environment where every teacher both shares experience and gains new knowledge.

Professional development is a continuous process, and sharing colleagues' experience is one of the most effective ways to improve teaching quality. It is exactly this kind of cooperation that creates an environment where new ideas, practical experience and innovative approaches become shared professional values.

We thank each participant — Rodami Mchedlishvili, Natela Kokhtashvili and Nino Tetiashvili — for their active involvement, openness and sincere sharing of professional experience.

This initiative will continue and become a tradition of collegial cooperation and professional development at the college.

30.title: Motivational Interviews for the IT Support Program
30.description:
June 18, 2026

Internal motivational interviews for applicants to the Information Technology Support program took place at Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College.

Thanks to the members of the commission, and good luck to our future students!

31.title: Collegial Learning Sessions #2
31.description:
The Collegial Learning Sessions continue at Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College — a space where teachers share their experience, effective teaching methods and successful practices with each other.

Every meeting confirms that sharing experience is one of the most effective paths to professional development.

Most importantly, together we are building a culture of good practice, where every idea can become the foundation of someone else's success. This is how a bank of good practice is created.

Thanks to each participant — Nino Mamulashvili, Ilia Matiashvili and Maka Barikhashvili — for their active involvement and sincere sharing of professional experience.

32.title: Our Teachers Present Papers at an International Conference at TSU
32.description:
On July 3, the 3rd International Conference "Transforming Vocational Education in the Global Era: Innovation, Skills and Partnership" was held at Ivane Javakhishvili Tbilisi State University, organized by its Vocational Education Center.

The event was attended by Baia Kvitsiani, Deputy Minister of Education, Science and Youth of Georgia, as well as representatives of the Parliament of Georgia, the National Center for Educational Quality Enhancement and Tbilisi City Hall.

From Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College, vocational teachers Ioseb Matiashvili and Ia Kviriashvili and student Tamuna Kurdghelashvili took part in the conference and presented their papers with distinction.

The papers presented at the conference were:

• "Cybersecurity — From the Traditional Educational Model to the Age of AI"
• "From Learning by Doing to Employment — The Impact of Vocational Education on Career Development"

We congratulate our colleagues on their successful participation in the international academic arena and wish them many more professional achievements!

33.title: Staff Excursion: Time Together and the Best Memories
33.description:
Time spent together and the best memories.

An excursion for the administration and teachers of Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College is always a chance to relax, strengthen relationships and recharge with new energy.

Lots of smiles, sincere emotions, interesting conversations and fun moments remind us once again that a strong team isn't built only at work — it is shaped by mutual support, trust and time spent together!

Shared activities like this strengthen team spirit, bring colleagues closer and help create a positive working environment.

Thank you to every participant for this unforgettable day!

A strong team begins with appreciating one another, continues with cooperation and grows stronger through memories made together.

34.title: Workshop: "The Formula for Success for Preschool Education Specialists"
34.description:
Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College organized a training workshop: "The Formula for Success for Preschool Education Specialists".

This college initiative brought vocational education and practice together in one space.

Under the memorandum signed with the Sagarejo Union of Preschool Institutions, the workshop was attended by preschool managers, caregivers, psychologists, students of the vocational program "Caregiver", and others interested in preschool education.

We thank the highly qualified trainers, Nino Khitarishvili and Mariam Goginashvili, who are deeply passionate about their work, for leading the meeting in such an interactive and engaging way.

We believe initiatives like this help strengthen the professional community and develop a culture of cooperation!

35.title: Selected Among the Top 7 Organizations of the Education Elevator Program
35.description:
Another important step on the path of international development!

We are happy to share that Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College has been selected among the top 7 participating organizations of the Education Elevator program.

After successfully completing the program's training and mentoring stage, representatives of the college administration will take part in a study visit to Estonia and Finland.

We believe that sharing international experience and getting to know European educational practices will make an important contribution to the further development of our college and create even more opportunities for our students.

Thank you to the Visionest Institute team for their trust and this important opportunity!

37.title: Pharmacy Students Pass the Qualification Exam
37.description:
Qualification exam passed successfully!

Students of the vocational program "Pharmacy (Pharmaceutical Services)" successfully passed both the theoretical and practical components of the qualification exam!

The chair of the commission, Nestan Urdulashvili, general manager of the Life clinic, gave high marks to the students' professional readiness to work in the pharmaceutical field.

We are happy that two years of hard work have paid off, and our graduates are now ready to start working in a real professional environment.

Special thanks to Nata Chkhaidze, representative of PSP Pharmacy, whose support, involvement and dedication are invaluable for our students' professional development.

We also sincerely thank program head Natela Kokhtashvili, the vocational teachers, the PSP Pharma mentors and everyone who helped shape our students into professionals.

This group is the college's seventh graduating class in this field, and the program's graduation rate stands at 95%.

We congratulate our students on this important success and wish them professional growth and successful careers!

Pre-registration for the program is open: https://shorturl.at/YLTmu

Study and find work in your own district. Don't put it off — we're waiting for you!

38.title: Caregiver Students Present Their Practical Projects
38.description:
The greatest success is when knowledge, hard work and love come together to raise the next generation!

Today, students of the vocational program "Caregiver" truly lived up to these words. Their practical project presentations clearly showed how much work, responsibility, creativity and love they have put into mastering their profession.

They completed their practical training at preschool institutions in Sagarejo Municipality, where they applied their theoretical knowledge in a real work environment and gained valuable professional experience.

Notably, they created a variety of learning resources and sketches with their own hands and donated them to the preschool institutions free of charge.

Special thanks to Maiko Kokhtashvili, Ia Kviriashvili, Nini Mekokishvili and everyone who contributed their knowledge, experience, support and sincere care to shaping these young women into professionals.

If you love children and see yourself in this profession, pre-register for the program now: https://shorturl.at/YLTmu

Study in your own district, grow professionally and work where your knowledge is needed most.

39.title: IT Program Head Completes International Training in Ankara
39.description:
Progress begins where experience knows no borders.

Ioseb Matiashvili, head of the Information Technology program at Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College, has returned from a one-week international study visit to Türkiye.

The network technologies training was held in Ankara from July 27 to August 3, 2026, in cooperation between the Turkish Cooperation and Coordination Agency (TİKA) and the Ministry of National Education of the Republic of Türkiye.

We thank TİKA and all the organizers for their support and fruitful cooperation.

Ioseb is now ready to share this international experience and best practices with our students and colleagues, supporting their professional development and improving the quality of teaching.

Congratulations to Ioseb on successfully completing this international project — we wish many more professional advances, new opportunities and international successes!

41.title: 3,141 Applicants Chose Vocational Education This Year
41.description:
This year, 3,141 applicants chose vocational education!

According to the National Assessment and Examinations Center (NAEC), 3,141 applicants earned the right to continue their studies in vocational education programs. Of these, 1,819 chose private vocational institutions and 1,322 chose public ones.

These figures show once again that vocational education is becoming an increasingly important and in-demand choice.

Today's young people are more practical, goal-oriented and results-driven. They want an education that gives them not only knowledge, but also specific professional skills, practical experience and a real chance of employment in a short time.

As the only college in the municipality, it is especially important for Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College to offer quality, results-oriented education to everyone interested in vocational education.

We believe an interesting, fruitful and successful road lies ahead of you — and we are ready to walk it together with you!

We also remind you that autumn registration for vocational programs is under way. It's never too late to learn — what matters is to start.

Make your choice and register: https://forms.gle/y1y4gMAge1LdERKt5

Questions? Call us: 595 944 244

42.title: Secondary Enrollment Has Started
42.description:
Secondary enrollment started today!

During this period, applicants can choose as many educational programs as they wish.

Who can take part?

• applicants who did not pass the minimum threshold in the Unified National Exams;
• applicants who passed the threshold but did not get into a university, while meeting the minimum threshold set for vocational programs.

The process ends on September 18 at 18:00.

Good luck!

We also remind you that autumn registration for our programs continues: 597 271 027

43.title: Collegial Learning Sessions #3
43.description:
The Collegial Learning Sessions continue at Ilia Chavchavadze Sagarejo Community College — a space where we learn from each other, share experience and look at our own practice with fresh eyes.

The third session was presented by teachers of the vocational program "Caregiver", Maiko Kokhtashvili and Ia Kviriashvili.

The topics and practical activities they chose took us back to childhood — they made us play, think and feel, and showed us once again how much meaning can hide behind a seemingly simple activity or word.

We were reminded of the importance of research, discovery and curiosity at any age — after all, learning is most exciting when you discover something new yourself.

Thanks to our presenters for an interesting, warm and meaningful session, and to every colleague for their active involvement and for sharing their experience.

We keep learning from each other, because good practice becomes strong when we share it.

information-technology.title: Information Technology Support
information-technology.description: Qualified training of specialists for personal computer hardware and software support.
information-technology.subtitle: Basic Vocational Qualification in Information Technology Support
information-technology.overview1: This qualification corresponds to the detailed field of Database and Network Design and Administration (code 0612) according to the International Standard Classification of Education (ISCED). It covers design, functioning, and integration of software applications, including computer media applications.
information-technology.overview2: The goal of the program is to provide the IT sector with competitive hardware and software support specialists. Students will learn to install, update, troubleshoot, optimize, and maintain operating systems and hardware. They will gain knowledge of core facts, principles, and general concepts of the field.
information-technology.structure: For Georgian speakers: 61 credits (17 general, 44 professional) - 11 months. For non-Georgian speakers: 76 credits (32 general, 44 professional) - 14 months.
information-technology.evaluation: Credits are awarded based on the confirmation of learning outcomes (recognition of formal/informal education or assessment). Formative and summative assessment systems are used, based on competency validation.
information-technology.careerText: Holders of this qualification can be employed as technical support specialists in any state/municipal organization or private company that utilizes information technology.

curriculumItems.title: Computer Assembly
curriculumItems.text: Assemble and configure a personal computer and peripheral devices.

curriculumItems.title: Operating Systems
curriculumItems.text: Install and set up operating systems and applications.

curriculumItems.title: Security
curriculumItems.text: Ensure OS security and assess hardware/software risks.

curriculumItems.title: Network Fundamentals
curriculumItems.text: Distinguish network principles, types, and TCP/IP, OSI models.

curriculumItems.title: Internal Networking
curriculumItems.text: Set up simple wired and wireless internal networks and ports.

curriculumItems.title: Diagnostics & Repair
curriculumItems.text: Identify and resolve hardware and software problems.

curriculumItems.title: Peripherals
curriculumItems.text: Install and configure various types of peripheral devices.

curriculumItems.title: Applied Software
curriculumItems.text: Install and configure various application software packages.

curriculumItems.title: Risk Assessment
curriculumItems.text: Evaluate hardware and software risks and determine preventive measures.

curriculumItems.title: Practical Tasks
curriculumItems.text: Implement necessary steps for completing complex technical tasks.

pharmacy.title: Pharmacy (Apothecary)
pharmacy.description: Training competitive pharmaceutical personnel for the healthcare sector.
pharmacy.subtitle: Higher Vocational Qualification in Pharmacy
pharmacy.overview1: According to the ISCED, this qualification belongs to the field of 'Pharmacy' (code 0916). The program studies drugs, their effects on humans, preparation, distribution, and administration.
pharmacy.overview2: The goal is to train professionals who can manage product reception and placement, inventory control, preparation of medications by prescription, and sales of over-the-counter products.
pharmacy.careerText: Holders of this qualification can be employed as pharmacists or pharmacy assistants in authorized pharmacies, wholesale facilities, and medical equipment stores.

curriculumItems.title: Visual Inspection
curriculumItems.text: Visually inspect products and establish identity with accompanying documentation.

curriculumItems.title: Inventory Control
curriculumItems.text: Perform incoming, periodic, and final control of pharmacy balances.

curriculumItems.title: Medication Preparation
curriculumItems.text: Prepare liquid, solid, and soft dosage forms according to prescriptions.

curriculumItems.title: Packaging
curriculumItems.text: Package original containers into smaller units, labeling and marking them.

curriculumItems.title: Consultation
curriculumItems.text: Provide consultation to users on product intake, use, and storage conditions.

curriculumItems.title: Sales & Ethics
curriculumItems.text: Sell over-the-counter products while following pharmaceutical ethics.

curriculumItems.title: Sanitary Norms
curriculumItems.text: Adhere to sanitary-hygienic norms, environmental rules, and safety regulations.

curriculumItems.title: Reporting
curriculumItems.text: Prepare and submit reports on product reception, inventory, and preparation.

pharmacy.structure: 3 general modules (11 credits), 26 professional modules (109 credits), and 1 elective (3 credits). For Georgian speakers: 123 credits (22 months). For non-Georgian speakers: 153 credits (28 months).
pharmacy.evaluation: Credits are awarded based on learning outcomes (formal/informal recognition or assessment). Uses formative and summative assessment systems.

veterinary-medicine.title: Veterinary Medicine
veterinary-medicine.description: Training of competitive and qualified veterinary technicians for the labor market.
veterinary-medicine.subtitle: Higher Vocational Qualification in Veterinary Medicine
veterinary-medicine.overview1: The program aims to prepare qualified veterinary technicians who can treat animals, respond to diseases and injuries, monitor post-operative conditions, and perform outpatient treatment.
veterinary-medicine.overview2: Graduates assist veterinarians in diagnostics, laboratory sampling, and surgical procedures. They participate in pre- and post-slaughter processes and perform technical tasks for artificial insemination.
veterinary-medicine.careerText: Holders of this qualification can be employed in veterinary clinics, farms, pharmacies, zoos, pet stores, animal shelters, laboratories, and meat processing plants.

curriculumItems.title: Animal Treatment
curriculumItems.text: Treating animals according to veterinary prescriptions.

curriculumItems.title: First Aid
curriculumItems.text: Providing veterinary first aid for minor injuries and emergency cases.

curriculumItems.title: Surgical Assistance
curriculumItems.text: Assisting veterinary surgeons during diagnostic and surgical operations.

curriculumItems.title: Artificial Insemination
curriculumItems.text: Performing technical tasks for animal artificial insemination.

curriculumItems.title: Lab Testing
curriculumItems.text: Collecting laboratory samples and conducting express tests.

curriculumItems.title: Dentistry Support
curriculumItems.text: Assisting veterinarians in routine animal dental procedures.

curriculumItems.title: Nutrition Monitoring
curriculumItems.text: Monitoring animal feed quality and feeding processes.

curriculumItems.title: Medical Records
curriculumItems.text: Recording and managing medications and pharmaceutical materials.

curriculumItems.title: Disease Prevention
curriculumItems.text: Participating in vaccination, disinfection, and quarantine measures.

curriculumItems.title: Slaughter Monitoring
curriculumItems.text: Monitoring pre-slaughter and slaughter processes for quality.

curriculumItems.title: Post-Slaughter Check
curriculumItems.text: Carrying out post-slaughter inspections under veterinary supervision.

curriculumItems.title: Consultation
curriculumItems.text: Providing basic recommendations on animal diseases and injuries.

veterinary-medicine.structure: The program includes 5 general modules (16 credits), 18 professional modules (64 credits), and 8 clinical training modules (40 credits). Total volume: 120 credits.
veterinary-medicine.evaluation: To attain the qualification, students must accumulate 120 credits, participate in intermediate assessments, and pass the final qualification exam.

early-childhood-education.title: Early Childhood Education
early-childhood-education.description: Prepare qualified personnel capable of caring for, educating, and developing children at early and preschool ages.
early-childhood-education.subtitle: Higher Vocational Qualification in Preschool Education.
early-childhood-education.overview1: The goal of the Preschool Educator vocational educational program is to prepare qualified personnel capable of caring for, educating, and developing children at early and preschool ages. For these purposes, the educator must ensure a safe and developmental educational environment and be able to communicate with the child's family, the staff of the early and preschool education institution, and representatives of the field, while caring for their own professional development.
early-childhood-education.overview2: The program provides for the development of eight key competencies (communication, mathematical, digital, independent learning, social, entrepreneurship, and cultural expression), which are important for raising a competitive professional.
early-childhood-education.careerText: After completing the program, a person can be employed in the position of a preschool educator or work as a self-employed educator.

curriculumItems.title: Holistic Development
curriculumItems.text: Holistic development of early and preschool age children, taking into account their age characteristics, interests, and individual abilities.

curriculumItems.title: Planning & Management
curriculumItems.text: Planning and managing a diverse, stimulating educational and pedagogical process.

curriculumItems.title: Development Strategies
curriculumItems.text: Using strategies that promote child development.

curriculumItems.title: Environment Creation
curriculumItems.text: Creating a successful, safe, and supportive educational environment.

early-childhood-education.structure: The program consists of 3 general mandatory modules (11 credits) and professional modules (105 credits). For Georgian speakers: 116 credits (21 months). For non-Georgian speakers: 146 credits (26 months).
early-childhood-education.evaluation: Credits are awarded based on the confirmation of learning outcomes (recognition or assessment). Formative and summative (competency validation) assessments are used.

financial-services.title: Financial Services
financial-services.description: Prepare qualified financial services personnel capable of providing various types of financial services.
financial-services.subtitle: Basic Vocational Qualification in Finance Services
financial-services.overview1: The goal of the program is to implement a vocational program that prepares qualified financial services personnel who can provide various types of financial services and inform customers about financial services.
financial-services.overview2: Graduates will master the conduct of cash and non-cash settlements, the performance of teller and banking operations, and the effective offering of banking products to clients.
financial-services.careerText: Holders of this qualification can be employed as cashiers in various retail outlets, and as tellers or operators in banks and non-banking credit-financial institutions.

curriculumItems.title: Settlements
curriculumItems.text: Conducting cash and non-cash settlements in retail and banking facilities.

curriculumItems.title: Banking Operations
curriculumItems.text: Implementing and managing teller and banking operations.

curriculumItems.title: Product Offering
curriculumItems.text: Introducing and offering banking products to clients.

curriculumItems.title: Customer Service
curriculumItems.text: Providing effective and professional service to customers.

financial-services.structure: Students must accumulate a total of 52-67 credits. For Georgian speakers: 52 credits (9.5 months). For non-Georgian speakers: 67 credits (13.5 months).
financial-services.evaluation: Credits are awarded based on the confirmation of learning outcomes (recognition or assessment). Formative and summative assessment systems are used.

administrative-services.title: Administrative Services
administrative-services.description: Prepare administrative specialists competitive in both local and international markets.
administrative-services.subtitle: Secondary Vocational Qualification in Administrative Services
administrative-services.overview1: The goal of the vocational educational program is to prepare personnel competitive in both local and international markets, capable of managing an organization's administrative functions.
administrative-services.overview2: The program covers document flow management, organization of procurement and supply, human resource issues planning, and business correspondence.
administrative-services.careerText: Administrative specialists can be employed in both public and private institutions as specialists in administrative structural units or as assistants to managers.

curriculumItems.title: Meeting Planning
curriculumItems.text: Effective planning and management of organizational meetings and business trips.

curriculumItems.title: Document Flow
curriculumItems.text: Managing organizational document flow, including forms and requisites.

curriculumItems.title: Procurement
curriculumItems.text: Managing organizational procurement, supply, and logistics.

curriculumItems.title: HR Management
curriculumItems.text: Planning and coordinating personnel and human resource management issues.

curriculumItems.title: Correspondence
curriculumItems.text: Conducting business correspondence and preparing draft documents.

curriculumItems.title: Archiving
curriculumItems.text: Preparing and organizing organizational documents for the archive.

administrative-services.structure: The program includes 14 professional and 6 general modules. For Georgian speakers: 70 credits (1 year). For non-Georgian speakers: 100 credits (1.6 years).
administrative-services.evaluation: Credits are awarded based on the confirmation of learning outcomes. Qualification requires accumulating defined credits and meeting legal requirements.

missionPage.heroSubtitle: The founding principles, strategic goals, and development vision of Ilia Chavchavadze Community College.
missionPage.missionP1: Ilia Ltd – Ilia Chavchavadze Community College of Sagarejo is a multi-profile professional educational institution whose mission is to prepare competitive and highly qualified personnel tailored to the requirements of the local and national labor market, thereby promoting the country's economic development, increasing social inclusion, and advancing individual professional growth.
missionPage.missionP2: The college aims to increase access to professional education and promote lifelong learning. It creates an inclusive, innovative, and student-centered educational environment directed at developing students' independent, entrepreneurial, and creative skills. The college's activities are based on close cooperation with the private sector and continuous improvement of compliance with modern standards of professional education.
missionPage.visionP1: The vision of Ilia Ltd – Ilia Chavchavadze Community College of Sagarejo is to become, within the next seven years, a multidisciplinary educational center that successfully implements professional programs of all levels across a wide range of professions tailored to the requirements of the labor market.
missionPage.visionP2: The college aims to become an example of quality professional education, innovative approaches, and collaborative culture in the region – recognized as an inspiring and desirable educational space for professional futures.
missionPage.valuesIntro: The activities of Ilia Ltd – Ilia Chavchavadze Community College of Sagarejo are based on values that reflect the professional ethics, vision, and culture of interaction of the college's team.

valuesList.teamwork: Teamwork – Collaboration, sharing experience, and joint focus on common goals;
valuesList.professionalism: Professionalism – Orientation towards high-quality, ethical and competent performance;
valuesList.dedication: Dedication – Sense of responsibility, motivation, and loyalty to the college's mission and student success;
valuesList.innovation: Innovation Support – Readiness to introduce modern approaches and technologies into the educational process;
valuesList.equality: Equality and Mutual Respect – Creating equal opportunities for all, maintaining a solidary and dignified environment.
